update.comment: BRT TreeComplexity, Random Seed, GLM-lasso Updates

action.item: ALTER TABLE wisdm_BRT ADD COLUMN TreeComplexity INTEGER
ALTER TABLE wisdm_ValidationOptions ADD COLUMN RandomSeed INTEGER

INSERT INTO wisdm_Models(ProjectID, ModelName, ModelType) SELECT ProjectID, "Generalized Linear Model - LASSO", "glm-lasso" FROM core_Project WHERE ProjectID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ProjectID FROM wisdm_Models WHERE ModelType = "glm-lasso")
